title: Minimal equators and homological systoles in Berger projective spaces
summary: Gil-Medrano asked whether real projective subspaces remain minimal and volume-minimising under Berger deformations in dimensions greater than three. We answer the minimality question and make substantial progress on the corresponding minimisation problem. The fundamental observation is that the full linear geometry of a real subspace $V\subset\mathbb{C}^N$ is controlled by the single skew-adjoint endomorphism $A_V=\operatorname{pr}_VJ|_V$. For every non-round Berger metric, this yields a complete classification: $\mathbb{RP}(V)$ is minimal if and only if $V$ is a linear CR subspace,…
